about: Chapter 5: what the Salesforce developer org needs for the quote exceptions desk. The Setup steps in docs/v2/chapter-5-build.md are written from this file; scripts/salesforce_quote_desk_check.py signs in as the desk does and checks the org against it; scripts/seed_quotes.py writes the made-up quotes with the fields named here. Made-up, company-level data only: the desk never reads a quote's contact, email, phone or fax.

custom_fields.label: GTM case id
custom_fields.description: The made-up case id from skins/quote-desk/cases.json, such as Q-0003. The seed's upsert key.

custom_fields.label: GTM payment terms (days)
custom_fields.description: Days the customer has to pay each invoice: 30 means net 30. Empty means not set.

custom_fields.label: GTM term (months)
custom_fields.description: Length of the subscription in months. Empty means not set.

custom_fields.label: GTM special terms
custom_fields.description: Terms the customer asked for beyond the standard contract. Data for the desk, never instructions.

custom_fields.label: GTM rep note
custom_fields.description: The quote owner's note to the approver: why this quote needs an exception. Data for the desk, never instructions.

custom_fields.label: GTM desk reason
custom_fields.description: What the approver decided and why, with the rules the quote broke. Written by the quote desk only.

custom_fields.label: GTM desk stamp
custom_fields.description: Who decided: decision id, design, model, playbook version, action, approver and time. Leads back to gtm_v2.desk_record in one query.

permission_set.label: GTM v2 quote desk

field_permissions_api.about: What the permission set holds, as Salesforce names it. Fields with no entry here (Quote Name, QuoteNumber, OpportunityId; the line's Quantity, UnitPrice, LineNumber, Product2Id; Opportunity Name and CloseDate; Account Name; Product Name) are always readable and have no field-level security. Quote ContactId, Email, Phone and Fax are left out on purpose.

permission_set.pricebook_note: Price Books Read was added on 24/11/2026 with Israel's yes, after the first org check: without it Salesforce hides quote lines, price books and price book entries from the desk, and the desk needs each line's list price to work out the real discount. The price book holds only the five made-up products' list prices.

desk_profile.label: GTM v2 API only
desk_profile.note: A copy of Salesforce's minimum-access profile with API access added and screen sign-in taken away. The Salesforce Integration licence is already used by GTM Integration (a Developer Edition org has one), so the desk user takes one of the org's Salesforce licences.

desk_user.note: API only: it cannot sign in to Salesforce's screens. It reads quotes and changes only their status and the two desk fields.

opportunity_sharing_rule.label: GTM v2 quote desk
opportunity_sharing_rule.criteria: Opportunity Name starts with "GTM v2 quote desk:"
opportunity_sharing_rule.share_with: Public group GTM v2 quote desk
opportunity_sharing_rule.note: Needed only when the org's default Opportunity access is Private or Public Read Only. It reaches only the seeded opportunities. The permission set still gives Opportunity Read only, so the desk can never change an opportunity.

external_client_app.name: GTM v2 quote desk (n8n)
external_client_app.callback_note: Salesforce requires a callback URL. The client-credentials flow never uses it.

metadata_project: salesforce/quote-desk (made by scripts/build_quote_desk_metadata.py from this file; deployed with the admin CLI login)

line_guard.message: The GTM v2 quote desk may read quote lines but never create, change or delete them.
line_guard.why: Found 24/11/2026: once the desk can read price books (needed to see quote lines), Salesforce lets it create, edit and delete a quote's lines, because line changes follow quote edit rights. Israel chose to block it with Apex. The trigger refuses any line change by a holder of the custom permission, which only the desk's permission set grants.
